paragraphs.source_en: “Jihei! The enemy’s banners? Look at the enemy’s banners!” Shigenari shouted as he frantically searched the crowd for Jihei. At that moment, battle cries also rose from the bank of the Nagase River near Kyūhōji village to the right.

units.source_en: “Jihei!
units.source_zh: “治兵卫！

units.source_en: The enemy’s banners?
units.source_zh: 敌人的军旗？

units.source_en: Look at the enemy’s banners!”
units.source_zh: 看一下敌人的军旗！”

units.source_en: Shigenari shouted as he frantically searched the crowd for Jihei.
units.source_zh: 重成慌忙在人群中寻找治兵卫的身影，大声道。

units.source_en: At that moment, battle cries also rose from the bank of the Nagase River near Kyūhōji village to the right.
units.source_zh: 此时，右边久宝寺村附近的长濑川河岸上，也响起了呐喊。

paragraphs.source_zh: “治兵卫！敌人的军旗？看一下敌人的军旗！”重成慌忙在人群中寻找治兵卫的身影，大声道。此时，右边久宝寺村附近的长濑川河岸上，也响起了呐喊。

paragraphs.source_en: “Jihei! Where is Jihei?”

units.source_en: “Jihei! Where is Jihei?”
units.source_zh: “治兵卫，治兵卫在何处？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “治兵卫，治兵卫在何处？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Here, my lord!”

units.source_en: “Here, my lord!”
units.source_zh: “小的在！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “小的在！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Judging by those cries, have we been surrounded by the enemy?”

units.source_en: “Judging by those cries, have we been surrounded by the enemy?”
units.source_zh: “听这呐喊声，难道我们被敌军包围了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “听这呐喊声，难道我们被敌军包围了？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Have no fear, my lord! The first cries came from Tōdō’s troops; those answering afterward from the left were our Chōsokabe forces.”

units.source_en: “Have no fear, my lord!
units.source_zh: “大人放心！

units.source_en: The first cries came from Tōdō’s troops; those answering afterward from the left were our Chōsokabe forces.”
units.source_zh: 先前呐喊的乃是藤堂军，次后左边呼应的乃是我军长曾我部。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人放心！先前呐喊的乃是藤堂军，次后左边呼应的乃是我军长曾我部。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Chōsokabe?”

units.source_en: “Chōsokabe?”
units.source_zh: “长曾我部？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “长曾我部？”

paragraphs.source_en: “We should leave Tōdō to Chōsokabe and withdraw to Wakae...”

units.source_en: “We should leave Tōdō to Chōsokabe and withdraw to Wakae...”
units.source_zh: “我们不如把藤堂交与长曾我部，撤到若江……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我们不如把藤堂交与长曾我部，撤到若江……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Silence! Would you have me flee before the enemy?”

units.source_en: “Silence!
units.source_zh: “住嘴！

units.source_en: Would you have me flee before the enemy?”
units.source_zh: 你是要我在敌军面前逃逸？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “住嘴！你是要我在敌军面前逃逸？”

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, if Kimura met the enemy here, it would be like striking a rock with an egg. Thus Chōsokabe’s appearance was timely aid indeed for Kimura. Yet Chōsokabe’s men had not come to aid Kimura. Driven by sheer fighting spirit, they too had charged as far as Yao, and near the embankment of the Tamakushi River they clashed fiercely with Tōdō’s troops.

units.source_en: In truth, if Kimura met the enemy here, it would be like striking a rock with an egg.
units.source_zh: 其实，木村若在此处迎敌，无异于以卵击石。

units.source_en: Thus Chōsokabe’s appearance was timely aid indeed for Kimura.
units.source_zh: 故，长曾我部的出现，对木村正可谓雪中送炭。

units.source_en: Yet Chōsokabe’s men had not come to aid Kimura. Driven by sheer fighting spirit, they too had charged as far as Yao, and near the embankment of the Tamakushi River they clashed fiercely with Tōdō’s troops.
units.source_zh: 只是，长曾我部的人马并非为了援助木村而来，他们亦是凭借着一身蛮劲冲到了八尾，直到玉串川堤坝附近，与藤堂部起了激烈冲突。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实，木村若在此处迎敌，无异于以卵击石。故，长曾我部的出现，对木村正可谓雪中送炭。只是，长曾我部的人马并非为了援助木村而来，他们亦是凭借着一身蛮劲冲到了八尾，直到玉串川堤坝附近，与藤堂部起了激烈冲突。

paragraphs.source_en: Tōdō Takatora had intended to advance early that morning. Just as he was about to depart, he heard gunfire from the direction of Dōmyōji. “Who can it be? It seems enemy troops are already advancing toward Kokubu.”

units.source_en: Tōdō Takatora had intended to advance early that morning.
units.source_zh: 藤堂高虎是日一大早便欲进军。

units.source_en: Just as he was about to depart, he heard gunfire from the direction of Dōmyōji.
units.source_zh: 正待出发时，他听见道明寺方向传来枪声。

units.source_en: “Who can it be?
units.source_zh: “是何人？

units.source_en: It seems enemy troops are already advancing toward Kokubu.”
units.source_zh: 看来已经有敌军朝国分进发。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 藤堂高虎是日一大早便欲进军。正待出发时，他听见道明寺方向传来枪声。“是何人？看来已经有敌军朝国分进发。”

paragraphs.source_en: If some meant to block the route to the Yamato entrance from Kokubu, then naturally others might advance from the Ōsaka highway in the north toward the Tateishi highway, or come by the Jūsō highway to the Kōya highway, in an attempt to intercept the main Kantō army. Takatora longed to report this urgent news at once to Ieyasu and his son, encamped at Hoshida and Sunagawa, but there was no time.

units.source_en: If some meant to block the route to the Yamato entrance from Kokubu, then naturally others might advance from the Ōsaka highway in the north toward the Tateishi highway, or come by the Jūsō highway to the Kōya highway, in an attempt to intercept the main Kantō army.
units.source_zh: 若有人试图从国分堵住大和口的去路，自然也会有人从北面的大坂官道朝立石官道进发，或从十三官道来到高野官道，试图堵截关东主力。

units.source_en: Takatora longed to report this urgent news at once to Ieyasu and his son, encamped at Hoshida and Sunagawa, but there was no time.
units.source_zh: 高虎恨不能立时将这紧急消息禀报驻于星田和砂的家康父子，却来不及了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 若有人试图从国分堵住大和口的去路，自然也会有人从北面的大坂官道朝立石官道进发，或从十三官道来到高野官道，试图堵截关东主力。高虎恨不能立时将这紧急消息禀报驻于星田和砂的家康父子，却来不及了。

paragraphs.source_en: Through the thin morning mist, enemy banners could be seen rising and falling like waves upon the sea. The forces of Kimura, Chōsokabe, Mashita, and Naitō had all begun to move around Yao, Anamō, Kayafuri, and Nishigōri.

units.source_en: Through the thin morning mist, enemy banners could be seen rising and falling like waves upon the sea.
units.source_zh: 透过薄薄的晨雾，可以看见敌军的旗帜像海浪一样此起彼伏。

units.source_en: The forces of Kimura, Chōsokabe, Mashita, and Naitō had all begun to move around Yao, Anamō, Kayafuri, and Nishigōri.
units.source_zh: 木村、长曾我部、增田、内藤各部，均已在八尾、穴太、萱振和西郡各地开始行动。

paragraphs.source_zh: 透过薄薄的晨雾，可以看见敌军的旗帜像海浪一样此起彼伏。木村、长曾我部、增田、内藤各部，均已在八尾、穴太、萱振和西郡各地开始行动。

paragraphs.source_en: Tōdō Yoshikatsu, commander of Tōdō’s right vanguard, had not yet realized that Kimura’s army had shifted position. “Kimura’s troops ignored us and went straight toward Wakae. They must intend to attack our main camps at Hoshida and Sunagawa. Allow me to go and take them from both sides, crushing them in a single stroke.”

units.source_en: Tōdō Yoshikatsu, commander of Tōdō’s right vanguard, had not yet realized that Kimura’s army had shifted position. “Kimura’s troops ignored us and went straight toward Wakae.
units.source_zh: 藤堂右先锋大将藤堂良胜尚未想及木村军已转移，道：“木村部对我军视而不见，径自朝若江方向去了。

units.source_en: They must intend to attack our main camps at Hoshida and Sunagawa.
units.source_zh: 他们定是想袭击我军在星田和砂的大营。

units.source_en: Allow me to go and take them from both sides, crushing them in a single stroke.”
units.source_zh: 请让在下前去两面包抄，一举将其攻破。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 藤堂右先锋大将藤堂良胜尚未想及木村军已转移，道：“木村部对我军视而不见，径自朝若江方向去了。他们定是想袭击我军在星田和砂的大营。请让在下前去两面包抄，一举将其攻破。”

paragraphs.source_en: Takatora was startled, but nodded his assent. If Ieyasu and Hidetada’s main camps were attacked, how could he, as vanguard commander, ever show his face again? He was about to strike Kimura’s troops from the flank when he encountered Chōsokabe; the two armies faced off and battle began.

units.source_en: Takatora was startled, but nodded his assent.
units.source_zh: 高虎吃了一惊，却点头应允。

units.source_en: If Ieyasu and Hidetada’s main camps were attacked, how could he, as vanguard commander, ever show his face again?
units.source_zh: 要是家康与秀忠的大营遭到敌军袭击，自己身为先锋，颜面何存？

units.source_en: He was about to strike Kimura’s troops from the flank when he encountered Chōsokabe; the two armies faced off and battle began.
units.source_zh: 他正欲从侧面袭击木村部，却碰上了长曾我部，于是两军对垒，开始厮杀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 高虎吃了一惊，却点头应允。要是家康与秀忠的大营遭到敌军袭击，自己身为先锋，颜面何存？他正欲从侧面袭击木村部，却碰上了长曾我部，于是两军对垒，开始厮杀。

paragraphs.source_en: Leaving Tōdō’s more than forty-seven hundred men to Chōsokabe, Kimura Nagato-no-kami Shigenari withdrew with his army to Wakae village. It was nearly the hour of the Hare. Day had fully broken, and the murky morning mist had dispersed.

units.source_en: Leaving Tōdō’s more than forty-seven hundred men to Chōsokabe, Kimura Nagato-no-kami Shigenari withdrew with his army to Wakae village. It was nearly the hour of the Hare.
units.source_zh: 木村长门守重成将藤堂的四千七百余人留给了长曾我部，率军撤退到若江村，已近卯时。

units.source_en: Day had fully broken, and the murky morning mist had dispersed.
units.source_zh: 天已大亮，迷蒙不清的晨雾也已散去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 木村长门守重成将藤堂的四千七百余人留给了长曾我部，率军撤退到若江村，已近卯时。天已大亮，迷蒙不清的晨雾也已散去。

paragraphs.source_en: Shigenari reined in his horse and divided his men into three forces. One, of course, was to meet Tōdō’s right wing; another, numbering more than two hundred and led by Kimura Muneaki, went north to Iwata; the main force remained south of Wakae, resting as it waited for the weary enemy.

units.source_en: Shigenari reined in his horse and divided his men into three forces. One, of course, was to meet Tōdō’s right wing;
units.source_zh: 重成驻马，将士众分为三路，其中一路自是迎击藤堂右翼；

units.source_en: another, numbering more than two hundred and led by Kimura Muneaki, went north to Iwata;
units.source_zh: 另一路二百余人由木村宗明率领，前往北面的岩田；

units.source_en: the main force remained south of Wakae, resting as it waited for the weary enemy.
units.source_zh: 主力则留在若江之南，以逸待劳。

paragraphs.source_zh: 重成驻马，将士众分为三路，其中一路自是迎击藤堂右翼；另一路二百余人由木村宗明率领，前往北面的岩田；主力则留在若江之南，以逸待劳。

paragraphs.source_en: Only later did Shigenari learn that the approaching enemy was Ii Naotaka’s brave force of thirty-two hundred, known as the “Tokugawa Red Brigade”; but how could he have known that when he gave his orders? Whatever enemy they met, they had to believe they could smash it in a single blow—Shigenari gradually regained his confidence and ordered Yamaguchi Hirosada and Naitō Nagaaki to lead their men in holding off Ii’s attack. He personally commanded the troops that met the Tōdō force pressing close upon them.

units.source_en: Only later did Shigenari learn that the approaching enemy was Ii Naotaka’s brave force of thirty-two hundred, known as the “Tokugawa Red Brigade”; but how could he have known that when he gave his orders?
units.source_zh: 不久重成才知，前来之敌乃是被称为“德川赤备军”的英勇之师井伊直孝的三千二百人，但在他下达命令的时候，哪里知道这些？

units.source_en: Whatever enemy they met, they had to believe they could smash it in a single blow—Shigenari gradually regained his confidence and ordered Yamaguchi Hirosada and Naitō Nagaaki to lead their men in holding off Ii’s attack.
units.source_zh: 不管遭遇何样敌人，都必须有将其一举击溃的信心——重成慢慢找回了自信，令山口弘定和内藤长秋率军先顶住井伊的进攻。

units.source_en: He personally commanded the troops that met the Tōdō force pressing close upon them.
units.source_zh: 他亲自指挥人马，迎击已紧紧逼来的藤堂之军。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不久重成才知，前来之敌乃是被称为“德川赤备军”的英勇之师井伊直孝的三千二百人，但在他下达命令的时候，哪里知道这些？不管遭遇何样敌人，都必须有将其一举击溃的信心——重成慢慢找回了自信，令山口弘定和内藤长秋率军先顶住井伊的进攻。他亲自指挥人马，迎击已紧紧逼来的藤堂之军。

paragraphs.source_en: Kimura Shigenari’s judgment was correct.

units.source_en: Kimura Shigenari’s judgment was correct.
units.source_zh: 木村重成的判断无误。

paragraphs.source_zh: 木村重成的判断无误。

paragraphs.source_en: When Tōdō Yoshikatsu and Yoshishige saw Kimura withdraw, they concluded that he meant to attack the main Kantō army from the flank. “If the main force is struck from the side, the Tōdō name will be disgraced!” So they abandoned Chōsokabe and pursued Kimura relentlessly.

units.source_en: When Tōdō Yoshikatsu and Yoshishige saw Kimura withdraw, they concluded that he meant to attack the main Kantō army from the flank.
units.source_zh: 藤堂良胜与良重见木村撤退，料定他是要从侧面袭击关东主力军。

units.source_en: “If the main force is struck from the side, the Tōdō name will be disgraced!”
units.source_zh: “要是主力遭侧袭，我藤堂岂不名声扫地！”

units.source_en: So they abandoned Chōsokabe and pursued Kimura relentlessly.
units.source_zh: 于是，他们放弃长曾我部，紧追木村不舍。

paragraphs.source_zh: 藤堂良胜与良重见木村撤退，料定他是要从侧面袭击关东主力军。“要是主力遭侧袭，我藤堂岂不名声扫地！”于是，他们放弃长曾我部，紧追木村不舍。

paragraphs.source_en: The first to charge Kimura’s right wing was Tōdō Yoshishige. Leaving his troops behind, he gave a great shout and charged alone into Kimura’s ranks, slashing wildly with his great blade.

units.source_en: The first to charge Kimura’s right wing was Tōdō Yoshishige.
units.source_zh: 首先杀向木村右翼的乃是藤堂良重。

units.source_en: Leaving his troops behind, he gave a great shout and charged alone into Kimura’s ranks, slashing wildly with his great blade.
units.source_zh: 他甩开后面的部队，大声叫喊，单枪匹马冲进木村的队伍，挥舞着大刀一阵乱砍。

paragraphs.source_zh: 首先杀向木村右翼的乃是藤堂良重。他甩开后面的部队，大声叫喊，单枪匹马冲进木村的队伍，挥舞着大刀一阵乱砍。

paragraphs.source_en: “The enemy commander is down. A good omen—forward, men!” Kimura Shigenari drew back several paces. Once battle was joined, Shigenari’s mind admitted no stray thought. At last regaining his composure, he braced his feet firmly in the stirrups and displayed calm self-command.

units.source_en: “The enemy commander is down.
units.source_zh: “灭了敌将。

units.source_en: A good omen—forward, men!”
units.source_zh: 好兆头，弟兄们冲啊！”

units.source_en: Kimura Shigenari drew back several paces.
units.source_zh: 木村重成稍稍退后几步。

units.source_en: Once battle was joined, Shigenari’s mind admitted no stray thought.
units.source_zh: 一旦厮杀战斗，重成便心无杂念。

units.source_en: At last regaining his composure, he braced his feet firmly in the stirrups and displayed calm self-command.
units.source_zh: 他好不容易镇定下来，紧紧蹬住脚下的马镫，显示出冷静和沉着。

paragraphs.source_zh: “灭了敌将。好兆头，弟兄们冲啊！”木村重成稍稍退后几步。一旦厮杀战斗，重成便心无杂念。他好不容易镇定下来，紧紧蹬住脚下的马镫，显示出冷静和沉着。

paragraphs.source_en: With Yoshishige wounded, Tōdō’s troops immediately fell into disorder. Once they lost their pillar of support, the signs of defeat appeared at once. Shigenari’s men, meanwhile, became beasts, hounding the bewildered enemy without mercy. Battle cries filled the air, and Tōdō’s soldiers screamed in terror.

units.source_en: With Yoshishige wounded, Tōdō’s troops immediately fell into disorder.
units.source_zh: 由于良重受伤，藤堂军顿时乱了阵脚。

units.source_en: Once they lost their pillar of support, the signs of defeat appeared at once.
units.source_zh: 一旦失去主心骨，败相立现。

units.source_en: Shigenari’s men, meanwhile, became beasts, hounding the bewildered enemy without mercy. Battle cries filled the air, and Tōdō’s soldiers screamed in terror.
units.source_zh: 重成属下则个个成了猛兽，对有些发懵的敌军穷追猛打，一时之间杀声四起，藤堂部众喊爹叫娘。

paragraphs.source_zh: 由于良重受伤，藤堂军顿时乱了阵脚。一旦失去主心骨，败相立现。重成属下则个个成了猛兽，对有些发懵的敌军穷追猛打，一时之间杀声四起，藤堂部众喊爹叫娘。

paragraphs.source_en: The two armies once more plunged into a fierce struggle to the death.

units.source_en: The two armies once more plunged into a fierce struggle to the death.
units.source_zh: 两军重新展开激烈的生死之搏。

paragraphs.source_zh: 两军重新展开激烈的生死之搏。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not give ground! Show them the might of Tōdō’s army!” Yoshikatsu roared, halting the routed men.

units.source_en: “Do not give ground!
units.source_zh: “休要退缩！

units.source_en: Show them the might of Tōdō’s army!”
units.source_zh: 让他们瞧瞧藤堂大军的威风！”

units.source_en: Yoshikatsu roared, halting the routed men.
units.source_zh: 良胜大吼一声，阻止溃众。

paragraphs.source_zh: “休要退缩！让他们瞧瞧藤堂大军的威风！”良胜大吼一声，阻止溃众。

paragraphs.source_en: Victory! Shigenari murmured the word to himself and struck the saddle in delight. Just then, a young warrior raised his spear high and thrust at Yoshikatsu. Yoshikatsu cast aside his spear, drew his sword, and fought back. Before many exchanges had passed, Yoshikatsu’s men hurriedly closed around him.

units.source_en: Victory!
units.source_zh: 胜了！

units.source_en: Shigenari murmured the word to himself and struck the saddle in delight.
units.source_zh: 重成默念一句，高兴地敲打着马鞍。

units.source_en: Just then, a young warrior raised his spear high and thrust at Yoshikatsu.
units.source_zh: 此时，一个小将高举着长枪朝良胜刺去。

units.source_en: Yoshikatsu cast aside his spear, drew his sword, and fought back.
units.source_zh: 良胜扔了长枪，拔出武刀相搏。

units.source_en: Before many exchanges had passed, Yoshikatsu’s men hurriedly closed around him.
units.source_zh: 不几回合，良胜手下已急急围了上去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜了！重成默念一句，高兴地敲打着马鞍。此时，一个小将高举着长枪朝良胜刺去。良胜扔了长枪，拔出武刀相搏。不几回合，良胜手下已急急围了上去。

paragraphs.source_en: Shigemura looked up and suddenly saw, beyond the soldiers, Yoshikatsu’s horse fleeing with a limp; Yoshikatsu himself was no longer in the saddle. He chuckled softly: Was the fellow dead, or merely wounded?

paragraphs.source_en: Ii Naotaka had already seen that the Ōsaka commanders intended to strike the flank of the main Kantō army by surprise. The Jūsō highway was ground the enemy had to cross, and so he had made these dispositions. After daybreak, the two sides confronted each other across the Tamakushi River, proving Naotaka’s judgment entirely correct. You shall not have your way! He gave a cold laugh, his eyes gleaming beneath his helmet.
